replay.compare: mixdog-core run_host/model_proxy_pc.rs: the same requests/ callbacks against the PC host; compare each case's fields whole (what the provider saw, claims named, refusal codes, resolve args, projected callbacks)
replay.entry: mixdog-core/src/run_host/model_proxy_trust_replay_tests.rs drives `modelProxy/run` on ModelProxyService (mixdog-core-domains/src/domains/ai_admin/model_proxy_service.rs, the service compose_flip.rs registers) over ProxyRunner (model_proxy.rs:864) with a scripted provider, and reads the typed `modelProxy/run/event` notifications; mixdog-ai/src/service/model_proxy_trust_replay_tests.rs replays "inline attachment data passes untouched, and nesting is bounded" through without_attachment_references (mixdog-ai/src/service/model_proxy.rs:76), which request_in applies to every free-form JSON field (model_proxy.rs part_in/message_in -> plain_json).

replaced.protocol: Node's claim/event/resolve host (modelProxyClaim/Event/Resolve, the heartbeat and its snapshot event) is replaced by the typed modelProxy/run request and its modelProxy/run/event notifications: mixdog-app-protocol/src/inventory.rs:848-858 marks the three operations Deleted
replaced.reason: every case's `wire` lines and `timers` are the envelope and heartbeat of the replaced protocol; what each case pins is compared through fieldMap

a stored-attachment reference from a ser.request.messages[0].content[1] (image wi: unrepresentable: ProxyImage (mixdog-app-protocol/src/v2/model_proxy.rs:55) is base64, url or file id; the three typed forms are sent and reach the provider unchanged
a stored-attachment reference from a ser.request.messages[0].content[2].content[0: a tool message's ProxyPart::File { source: Unavailable (v2/model_proxy.rs:67), filename } -> the provider's text part, compared with providerSaw[0].content[2].content[0].text
a stored-attachment reference from a ser.pcSecretBase64 / readBackHere / stored: the PC's own store: ProxyRunner (model_proxy.rs:864) holds no attachment store; asserted absent from what the provider saw

1,000 advertised ids never produce more.maxSnapshotEntries / advertised / rounds: no snapshot exists on the typed protocol: each call is its own modelProxy/run request (mixdog-app-protocol/src/methods.rs:4338); the server does not count them against its class cap (mixdog-app-server/src/server.rs, the cap of modelProxy/run), as Node's host has none: the recorded burst of case 4 is admitted whole (mixdog-app-server tests/admission.rs the_recorded_burst_of_model_proxy_runs_is_admitted_whole); each call is one frame of at most maxInboundFrameBytes, tested by a_peer_holds_at_most_its_in_flight_runs_each_one_bounded_frame

payloads past the aggregate in-flight li.maxInflightBytes / payloadChars / second: ModelProxyService (mixdog-core-domains ai_admin/model_proxy_service.rs admit) refuses as Node's admitPayload does: a call whose payload (the characters of the call's JSON) would take the data held by the calls in flight past maxInflightBytes (recorded as 3,000; the service's default is Node's 256 MiB) is the failure MODEL_PROXY_BUSY, status 429, with Node's words, before any provider is looked up, and a call past 128 MiB is MODEL_PROXY_REQUEST_TOO_LARGE (413); replayed by a_call_that_would_take_the_data_held_past_its_bound_is_refused_as_busy; a frame past maxInboundFrameBytes is refused before it is parsed (mixdog-app-protocol/src/rpc.rs:142), tested by a_peer_holds_at_most_its_in_flight_runs_each_one_bounded_frame
payloads past the aggregate in-flight li.oversizedReply / hostOperations: a run sends notifications and asks the peer nothing (model_proxy_service.rs RunEvents::emit), so there is no peer reply to bound; any inbound frame is under the same frame bound

a burst of sends all run, with no rate o.sends / results[].content: 30 concurrent modelProxy/run calls on ModelProxyService; each answers `sent` and its textDelta events fold to the content
a burst of sends all run, with no rate o.hostRunningAfter: ModelProxyService::close returns at once: no run left

callbacks reach the server only allowlis.stages[account-changed] {provider, at}: ProxyEvent::AccountChanged { provider, at } (v2/model_proxy.rs:646): the account id is not a field of the event
callbacks reach the server only allowlis.stages[reconnecting].attempt / max: unrepresentable: the core's account pool states a message only (AccountStage::Switching, mixdog-core-api/src/domain/provider.rs:135; key_pool.rs:287); Node's real pool states none either (account-pool.mjs reconnecting: { message }), the counters are the recorder's scripted provider
callbacks reach the server only allowlis.deltas (onStreamDelta of a 200-char stri: unrepresentable: onStreamDelta's kind is the ProxyProgress enum (v2/model_proxy.rs:596), never free text
callbacks reach the server only allowlis.result.content: the textDelta events of the run, folded; the provider is scripted with the recorder's own 'ok', and the run's whole ordered event list is compared in the order Node's wire recorded the callbacks (stages, then toolExcluded; onStreamDelta has no typed event): the scripted provider reports the tool it left out after its two stage events; the text and the scripted stream's completed event close the list
callbacks reach the server only allowlis.result.secretHookKnown / secretHookCalle: unrepresentable: a typed request (ProxyOptions, v2/model_proxy.rs:194) carries no callback, so a provider cannot learn of one
callbacks reach the server only allowlis.allowlistedCallbacks: the CALLBACKS table of the replay test: each Node callback and the ProxyEvent variants that carry it, keys compared in order
